leaderboard.style: founder data-flex: video proof, self-quote of prior call, amplify-own-thesis on Elon quote
short product Qs and self-thread clarifiers (Grok Bot / Wen Grok 5?)
first-minute crypto/meme hijack with video, off-topic bike-tyson spam on Elon posts
Grok Bot promo one-liners, product-plug on Elon AI posts
witty one-liner on leaks plus genuine-adjacent license aphorism on vendor posts

patterns: Named seats sama/karpathy/simonw/openai/anthropic/openaidocs posted nothing in-window; volume sat on elonmusk quotes, a viral Claude-Code burnout rant, OSS model-flex, Gemini-fail jokes, Qwen license, Tibo Codex tease, Opus 5.5 leak.
Elon-scale threads: like-chart captured in first 30–120s by reply-guys (crypto, parody, beauty-bench promo, image/video, one-liners); expert replies rarely crack top-5 even at +30m.
AI-community threads (Ahmad/Qwen/lyra/minchoi): first 5–40m is questions, benchmark flex, license legalism; OP follow-ups often outrank strangers.
Viral complaint (v0xium): high-like empathy/expertise lands +2–3h; celebrity one-liner (elonmusk Yikes) arrives +22h and dwarfs every other reply.

Formats that win: one-liner on Elon; joke-as-Gemini-read on Logan (system-prompt / Gemini 4 cancelled / puts); data flex (27B at frontier, 3.8 vs opus 4.6, video math); genuine expertise as medium legal/ops paragraphs on Qwen; leak one-liners plus OP score-claim.
Length: sub-10 words on mega-accounts; 1–3 sentences on OSS/leak; long-form only on burnout (and even then Elon’s one word beat them).
Timing windows: reply-guy <2m; community Q/expertise 5–40m; vendor-clarifier ~1–90m; celebrity dunk hours later; OP self-replies cluster 10–40m.
Verbatim-quote-of-the-post is a quote-tweet move (svembu) more than a reply; contrarian takes (quit / be glad you have a job) score on the rant, not on Elon.
Tibo cryptic one-liner spawned interpret-the-oracle replies plus @grok timezone decoding, not expertise.
License posts attract the same question restated: commercial use of outputs vs weights — first asker in +90s gets the likes.
